proposal.falsifier: Falsified against the frozen fields (model id b-transient-behavior-v1) if any of: (a) the step-4 boot predicate deviates from saved_activity.first_boot_s by more than 2*excitation_record.dt_s in either world - world B (component_record eeb8277f, excitation_record 219fd490, saved_activity a4c4b294: predicted 0.0129 s vs recorded 0.0129 s) or world A (component_record 55d43741, excitation_record 2820ae58, saved_activity ae3c8933: predicted 0.0027 s vs recorded 0.0027 s); (b) the predicted tx-complete deviates from max over saved_activity.activity[*].time_s where action == 'tx-complete' by more than 2*dt_s (world B: predicted 0.0159 s vs recorded 0.0158 s); (c) the shunt-class term fails to reproduce excitation_record.shunts[0].energy_j withdrawn at shunts[0].time_s driving stored below the off_v threshold energy and so predicting the recorded energy-threshold brownout within 2*dt_s (world A: predicted 0.0121 s vs recorded 0.0121 s); (d) triage misclasses a retained episode - if saved_activity.packets holds a frame with application_bytes == service.application_bytes, one event_id and time_s <= receive_deadline_s (a4c4b294) and step 1 still reports a retained failure, or if packets is empty (ae3c8933) and step 1 reports ACHIEVED, or if any event with time_s > t_last_tx is used to justify a knob change or to spend a candidate execution; (e) a design with positive slack on every step-4 inequality is observed to deliver no valid frame, or a design violating the TX loaded-voltage feasibility line is observed to deliver one; (f) an absent check (ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE) or absent source (UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE) is recorded anywhere as pass or fail rather than UNKNOWN. A firing on (a)-(c) is classified transcription/arithmetic and corrects only the text; a firing on (d)-(f) is substantive and reverts the named rule to H0's base text. Whatever fires is retained verbatim: ar_product fixed_space NO_GO / product NOT_ACCEPTED / strict_FIFO FAIL, current_b_run received_frames 0 with start_voltage_v 0, p2's two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections and its misrouted-payload note, p3's recorded 8-tick gate miss, every UNKNOWN physical qualification and every actual acquisition cost. Physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service remain UNKNOWN; nothing here asserts acceptance, and no clause is satisfiable by an unavailable tool.
proposal.hypothesis: H0 (sha 1784856e) is ambiguous in three ways that the retained public episodes actually resolve: (1) it says to select a legal design and 'actually check it', but p2's check returned ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE and its submission path returned EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT with no retry, so 'checked' cannot be a precondition of proceeding and an absent check is an UNKNOWN, not a fail; (2) it gives no terminality rule, so the p3 record's 0.3395 s post-terminal brownout (saved_activity a4c4b294, last tx-complete 0.0158 s, packet 8 bytes at 0.0158 s against a 0.1 s deadline) is easy to misread as the failure, and a knob moved in that direction (less capacitance, later gate) removes TX headroom and can create the real loss; (3) it has no world-branching, so one world's numbers can be transplanted into the other even though p2's world (component_record 55d43741: event_latch volatile, source split [0,0.006) 16.667 mW and [0.03,0.06) 3.667 mW, shunt 4e-5 J at 0.012 s) and p3's world (eeb8277f: passive-mechanical latch, one 0-0.02 s segment at 7.5 mW, no shunts) differ in every mechanism. Hypothesis: a source-parameterized procedure that (i) triages terminality first, (ii) binds every symbol to a named source field, (iii) branches on latch class, segmentation class, shunt class and threshold class read per run, and (iv) retains when all inequalities hold with positive slack, reproduces the one recorded achieved delivery and the one recorded real loss without stating any device value, and keeps every UNKNOWN and cost visible. This is a procedure claim under the frozen model and retained fields; physical calibration stays UNKNOWN and no acceptance is asserted.
proposal.method_text:
H update v3 (independent G1 descendant of H0 sha 1784856e, drafted under prefix sha 01bf9c13): source-parameterized, triage-first, world-branched, rehearsal-gated procedure. Everything numeric in the steps below is a symbol bound to a named source field and is resolved only from the consuming run's own acquired sources; no number here is a recommended device setting, no D candidate is supplied, and no acceptance is claimed. Numbers appear only in STEP 7, which is labelled illustrative and recomputes them from the named retained fields.

STEP 0 - Entry ledger (record before deriving anything). Record: H0 sha 1784856e, prefix sha 01bf9c13, the exact action set that entry offers (design entries observed so far offer inspect, sources, acquire, check, submit), and, per referenced episode, whether a design check existed: p2 returned ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE; p3's check ran and recorded physical_qualification UNKNOWN. No step below may depend on a check being offered, and an unavailable check or unavailable source is written UNKNOWN, never pass or fail. Candidate executions and selection budget belong to the consumer, never to this draft.

STEP 1 - Triage-first reading (mandatory first step, before any diagnosis).
1.1 ACHIEVED iff saved_activity.packets contains an entry with application_bytes == service.application_bytes, a single event_id, and time_s <= service.receive_deadline_s.
1.2 Let t_last_tx = max over saved_activity.activity[*].time_s where action == 'tx-complete' (undefined if none). Every activity event with time_s > t_last_tx is POST-TERMINAL: recorded as expected decay, benign, and never a reason to change a knob or spend an execution.
1.3 If ACHIEVED: stop energy diagnosis; no knob change, no check spent to confirm, no candidate execution; go to STEP 5.1.
1.4 Otherwise classify exactly one retained failure class: F1 no delivery by receive_deadline_s; F2 no boot (energy-threshold domain); F3 latch lost between first capture and tx-complete (reachable only when component_record.event_latch == 'volatile'); F4 tx-transient brownout during transmission; F5 frame-shape violation (bytes, uniqueness, count).

STEP 2 - Facts and cost. acquire every source id entry lists; per source store source_sha256, bytes, native_calls, new_scientific_executions, wall_seconds and any error string verbatim. If acquisition returns UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE (as all three attempts did while drafting this H), record UNKNOWN, fall back to entry-projected fields only, and mark every derived number UNVERIFIED against live acquisition. Never re-infer a number from memory of a different episode.

STEP 3 - World branching, read per run, never transplanted. Bind four classes:
W1 component_record.event_latch in {volatile, passive-mechanical}.
W2 excitation_record.source_segments is one contiguous lit interval versus two or more segments separated by an unlit gap.
W3 excitation_record.shunts empty versus a list of (time_s, energy_j) withdrawals.
W4 thresholds as logged: ready_v, off_v, cap_voltage_max_v (a drift changes E_on = 0.5*capacitance_f*ready_v^2 and every consequence).
Class-conditional rules, each applied only inside its class:
- W1 volatile: because a brownout destroys the latched event, the hard invariant is 'no stored energy below the off_v threshold energy between first capture and tx-complete'. W1 passive-mechanical: the event survives a brownout, so the invariant reduces to 'tx-complete <= receive_deadline_s' and a mid-flight reset merely costs a retry.
- W2 contiguous: the whole transmit window must lie inside the lit interval. W2 segmented: the transmit must start and complete inside one lit segment, since the unlit gap supplies nothing and capture-to-transmit hold time is bounded by stored energy, not by wall-clock.
- W3 shunts present: every shunts[i].energy_j is subtracted from stored energy at its time_s; this term is mandatory and is one world's observed loss mechanism. W3 no shunts: no such term.
- W4: sleep drain is off_power_w below off_v, awake drain is idle_power_w, and storage is clamped at 0.5*capacitance_f*cap_voltage_max_v^2.

STEP 4 - Symbolic ledger, recomputed from the fields (never pasted between worlds). Symbols: C = capacitance_f; V_on = ready_v; V_off = off_v; V_max = cap_voltage_max_v; E_boot = boot_j; t_bd = boot_delay_s; eta = harvest_efficiency; P_off = off_power_w; P_idle = idle_power_w; P_tx = output_v*tx_current_a; t_tx = tx_duration_s; g = tx_not_before_s; R = esr_ohm; dt = excitation_record.dt_s.
E_on = 0.5*C*V_on^2; E_off = 0.5*C*V_off^2; E_max = 0.5*C*V_max^2; E_tx = P_tx*t_tx.
P_lit(t) = power_w of the segment with start_s <= t < end_s, else 0 (no segment = no harvest).
Grid step by state: step_off = (eta*P_lit - P_off)*dt while asleep; step_awake = (eta*P_lit - P_idle)*dt while awake; stored clamped at E_max; each shunts[i].energy_j subtracted at its time_s.
Boot predicate is threshold-first and tick-quantized: the first grid instant where accumulated stored >= E_on; then stored := stored - E_boot, and the radio is enabled at that instant + t_bd. Hence t_boot = n_boot*dt with n_boot = ceil(E_on/step_off) accumulated on the lit grid; t_ready = t_boot + t_bd + max(0, g - t_boot); t_done = t_ready + ceil(t_tx/dt)*dt.
TX floor comes from the model's loaded-voltage guard, not from V_off: E_floor = 0.5*C*(output_v + R*P_tx/output_v)^2 (loaded rail during transmission).
Inequalities, each logged with numeric slack: (i) t_done <= receive_deadline_s; (ii) stored_at_ready - E_floor + (eta*P_lit - P_idle)*t_tx - E_tx >= 0, i.e. transmission finishes without a tx-transient reset; (iii) predicted stored peak inside the frame window <= E_max (no spill corrupting the charge budget); (iv) under W1 volatile: no predicted dip below E_off while the event is latched, including across any W3 withdrawal, which yields the necessary condition E_max - sum(shunts.energy_j) > E_off for shunt-class worlds.

STEP 5 - Change-or-retain decision rules.
5.1 ACHIEVED and every inequality has positive slack: RETAIN the inherited design, spend no candidate execution, and annotate post-terminal events as benign.
5.2 Otherwise change exactly one legal knob in the direction the sign of the violated inequality demands (raise C when (ii) or (iv) fails; lower C, or move the radio gate earlier, when (i) or (iii) fails), recompute all inequalities, and only then spend one candidate execution.
5.3 Never change two knobs in one execution; never justify a change by a post-terminal event; never spend an execution to confirm a ledger that already has positive slack; never run a control outside the derived feasible region.
5.4 Selection is by band, not by guessing a value: over the legal capacitance_f and tx_not_before_s ranges reported by entry, compute each inequality's slack, normalize each by its own tolerance, and take the design maximizing the minimum normalized slack; ties break toward the smaller capacitance and the earlier gate. A band edge is chosen only if it wins that min-slack rule.
5.5 Keep the timing gate at its earliest legal setting unless the retained failure class names a capture gate, because a positive gate spends idle energy and pushes t_done toward the deadline.

STEP 6 - Verification honesty and channel discipline. If entry offers check, attempt exactly one check of the chosen design; on ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE record the design as UNVERIFIED/UNKNOWN and state that the ledger is the only evidence. If a submission path rejects the payload (observed: EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT on a submit and on a re-aimed propose of the same payload, with no retry; and, in this proposal episode, a schema validation rejection of a correctly founded payload that carried one extra field), record the rejection verbatim, do not re-route the same payload under another label, and do not claim the method is in force.

STEP 7 - Retrospective rehearsal gate before this H is ever proposed (illustrative arithmetic, recomputed from the named retained fields). Instantiate the procedure on the frozen episode its mechanism came from and split every mismatch into transcription/arithmetic (correct the text and redraft) or substantive (abandon or change the named rule).
(a) World B (component_record eeb8277f, excitation_record 219fd490, saved_activity a4c4b294): C = 2.2e-5 F gives E_on = 8.624e-5 J; step_off = (0.9*7.5e-3 - 2e-5)*1e-4 = 6.73e-7 J; n_boot = ceil(E_on/step_off) = 129 ticks, stored after E_boot = 8.1817e-5 J, so t_boot = 0.0129 s which matches first_boot_s exactly (0 ticks); t_ready = 0.0129 + 1e-3 and t_done = 0.0159 s against a recorded tx-complete of 0.0158 s (1 tick). Triage: packets[0] has 8 bytes, event_id 1, 0.0158 <= 0.1 -> ACHIEVED; the 0.3395 s brownout is after t_last_tx and benign. Inequalities hold with positive slack, so 5.1 retains and spends nothing: the recorded achieved delivery is reproduced.
(b) World A (component_record 55d43741 with event_latch volatile, excitation_record 2820ae58 with two segments and a shunt at 0.012 s, saved_activity ae3c8933): with C = 1e-5 F, E_on = 3.92e-5 J, step_off = (0.9*1.6667e-2 - 2e-5)*1e-4 = 1.498e-6 J, n_boot = 27 ticks and stored after E_boot = 3.5446e-5 J, i.e. t_boot = 0.0027 s matching first_boot_s; storage then clamps at E_max = 5.445e-5 J and the 4e-5 J withdrawal at 0.012 s leaves 1.445e-5 J < E_off = 1.62e-5 J, predicting the energy-threshold brownout at 0.0121 s as recorded (<= 1 tick). packets is empty, so triage yields a retained F3 failure (captures at 0.0037-0.0079 s, no tx-complete ever), not a post-terminal artifact. The exact post-brownout reboot tick (recorded 0.0381 s) is not predicted here and is carried as UNKNOWN rather than fitted.
(c) Transcription check on the predecessor reading: the earlier written formula folded E_boot into the ceil numerator and then added the boot delay on top, predicting t_done = 0.0166 s against a recorded tx-complete of 0.0158 s (8 ticks). Under this step that split is transcription, so only the text is corrected to the threshold-first predicate of STEP 4; the recorded gate miss stays on the record and no rule is abandoned.

STEP 8 - Retention and scope. Preserve verbatim: ar_product (fixed_space NO_GO, product NOT_ACCEPTED, strict_FIFO FAIL); current_b_run (received_frames 0, start_voltage_v 0, deadline 0.1 s); p2's two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections and its misrouted-payload note; p3's recorded gate miss; every UNKNOWN check, every UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE fallback and every actual acquisition cost (bytes, native_calls, new_scientific_executions, wall_seconds). This H edits no task field, physics, initial state, service field, evaluator or budget, supplies no D candidate, and asserts no acceptance: physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service remain UNKNOWN, and no hardware, statistical, transfer, migration or recursive-self-improvement claim is made.

proposal.falsifier:
Each prediction names the frozen field that would disconfirm it, a tolerance in dt ticks (= excitation_record.dt_s), and what is retained if it fires.

P1 boot timing. Predicted t_boot = ceil(E_on/step)*dt with E_on = 0.5*component_record.capacitance_f*component_record.ready_v^2 and step = (excitation_record.source_segments[0].power_w*component_record.harvest_efficiency - component_record.off_power_w)*dt. Disconfirmed if |t_boot - saved_activity.first_boot_s| > 1*dt_s. Also disconfirms the boot-ordering convention (threshold reached first, boot_j debited at that tick) if the implied tick differs by more than 1.

P2 transmit completion. Predicted t_txdone = t_boot + boot_delay_s + ceil(tx_duration_s/dt)*dt. Disconfirmed if |t_txdone - saved_activity.packets[0].time_s| > 2*dt_s, using saved_activity.activity tx-complete/tx-start times as corroboration.

P3 triage. The classification of saved_activity a4c4b294 as ACHIEVED, and of its 0.3395 s brownout as post-terminal, must follow from saved_activity.packets[0].application_bytes, event_id and time_s together with service.application_bytes and service.receive_deadline_s alone. Disconfirmed if any reading of those fields classifies the delivery otherwise (i.e. if the triage rule would call an achieved frame a failure or a benign event a failure).

P4 boot-energy convention. Predicted boot energy n_boot*step - boot_j must match saved_activity.activity[0].energy_j within 2 steps, with boot_j = component_record.boot_j. Disconfirmed by that field pair if the residual is larger, which would mean the boot_j debit or the step expression is transcribed wrongly.

P5 substantive reading of the other world. With p2's own fields (component_record 55d43741, excitation_record 2820ae58, saved_activity ae3c8933) alone, the ledger plus hold inequality (iv) must show the volatile-latch hold plan crossing the dark gap between the two source segments and the scheduled shunt debit as insufficient. Disconfirmed if, using those fields alone and no p3 number, the recorded design satisfies inequalities (i)-(iv) with positive margins; then the world-branching claim is withdrawn.

Fire rules. A P1/P2/P4 miss beyond tolerance is classified transcription: correct the offending formula, redraft, keep the design and the miss itself on record. A P3 or P5 failure is substantive: revert to H0's base method for that branch. If a prediction fires, the failed prediction, the classification, the executions actually spent and the acquisition cost are retained verbatim; nothing is relabelled as a pass, and no design in force is presented as qualified or accepted. The falsifier is evaluated only from frozen public sources and recorded observations, never from check or submit availability, so an episode returning ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE or EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT can neither satisfy nor evade it. Physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service remain UNKNOWN on every branch, and no hardware, statistical, transfer or RSI result is asserted.
proposal.hypothesis: H0 says 'select a legal design ... actually check it, then submit', but leaves three things undefined: what a brownout after the frame is worth, what an unavailable check means, and whether one episode's numbers may be carried into another. The retained evidence prices that ambiguity. p3's saved_activity a4c4b294 holds an ACHIEVED delivery (8 application bytes, one event id, 0.0158 s against a 0.1 s deadline) followed by a 0.3395 s brownout that occurs after the only source segment ended at 0.02 s, and p3's earlier H v2 spent its gate on an 8-tick deviation of its own written formula while the design itself succeeded. p2's saved_activity ae3c8933 holds a real loss by contrast: no packets, a volatile latch, an energy-threshold brownout at 0.0121 s and a reboot at 0.0381 s with event_was_captured=false. Hypothesis: if H is consumed from task entry, its triage-first step classifies p3 as ACHIEVED and spends no execution reacting to post-terminal decay; its per-run world read keeps the volatile-latch gap-plus-shunt reading of p2 out of p3's arithmetic and p3's single-segment numbers out of p2's; and its threshold-first symbolic ledger reproduces the recorded boot tick and the recorded packet time within a stated tick tolerance when instantiated on p3's own fields. The procedure would therefore have retained p3's working design rather than moved a knob, and would have exposed p2's loss through a hold inequality instead of by transplanting values. This is a claim about reading order and derivation only, on frozen public sources; physical calibration stays UNKNOWN and no acceptance is claimed.
proposal.method_text:
H v3 method: triage-first, world-branching, rehearsal-gated selection written symbolically. It governs only reading, derivation, change-or-retain, rehearsal and logging performed by a consumer starting from task entry. It never edits the task, service fields, physics, sources, evaluator, budgets or tools, and it supplies no device candidate and no acceptance claim; acceptance is external.

STEP 0 - ENTRY LEDGER (recorded before any diagnosis).
Record (a) the base H sha this draft descends from (H0 sha256 1784856e); (b) the proposal-prefix sha256 01bf9c13; (c) the action set the entry actually offers, read literally from the entry's own tool/action enum, without assuming that check, submit or propose exist; (d) per retained episode, whether a design check existed: p2's check returned ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE and is recorded as UNKNOWN, never as pass and never as fail; p3's check ran and recorded physical_qualification=UNKNOWN. Any later step that needs an absent action is recorded UNKNOWN and its design stays UNVERIFIED.

STEP 1 - TRIAGE FIRST (mandatory step 1, before any mechanism is named).
Symbols bound to fields: A = service.application_bytes; Ddl = service.receive_deadline_s; F = saved_activity.packets[]; T_term = max{ saved_activity.activity[k].time_s : that event is tx-complete } (if none, no terminal event exists yet).
Delivery is ACHIEVED iff some packet p in F has p.application_bytes = A, exactly one distinct event id over the required event, and p.time_s <= Ddl. Every activity event with time_s > T_term is POST-TERMINAL: expected decay after the powered window ends. Post-terminal events are recorded and are never a reason to change a knob.
A retained failure is only: no ACHIEVED packet, or an ACHIEVED packet that violates a service field. Classify it as (a) deadline miss, t_txdone > Ddl; (b) no-boot / threshold domain; (c) tx-transient loss, i.e. a brownout with event_was_captured = false or a capture missing after reboot between capture and tx-complete; (d) frame-shape violation (bytes, uniqueness, count).
If no class is present, go to STEP 4.1: retain, and spend no execution.

STEP 2 - READ THIS RUN'S WORLD (never transplant another run's numbers).
Read per run: L = component_record.event_latch in {volatile, passive-mechanical}; Segs = excitation_record.source_segments[] as (start_s, end_s, power_w); Sh = excitation_record.shunts[] as (time_s, energy_j); dt = excitation_record.dt_s; and from component_record: capacitance_f, ready_v, off_v, cap_voltage_max_v, cap_initial_voltage_v, boot_j, boot_delay_s, esr_ohm, output_v, tx_current_a, tx_duration_s, off_power_w, idle_power_w, harvest_efficiency.
Branch on the value class actually present. (i) L = volatile means captured information survives only while the rail stays above its off threshold, so hold inequality (iv) in STEP 3 binds. L = passive-mechanical means the capture is retained across an unpowered interval, so (iv) is recorded NOT_BINDING and only (i)-(iii) govern. (ii) Segs and the gaps between them define contiguous powered windows; a gap cannot charge. (iii) If Sh is non-empty, every hold plan is evaluated against those scheduled debits at their own time_s. The p2 world (event_latch volatile, a high-power early segment, a later low-power segment, a dark gap between them, one shunt at 0.012 s) and the p3 world (passive-mechanical, one single segment [0, 0.020) s, no shunt) are different value classes: neither world's numbers may appear in the other's derivation.

STEP 3 - SYMBOLIC LEDGER (a prediction, computed before an execution is spent).
E_on = 0.5*C*ready_v^2; E_off = 0.5*C*off_v^2; E_max = 0.5*C*cap_voltage_max_v^2;
E_floor = 0.5*C*(output_v + esr_ohm*tx_current_a)^2, the loaded-voltage guard inside transmission, which binds above E_off;
step_j = (power_w_j*harvest_efficiency - off_power_w)*dt for a tick inside segment j; if step_j <= 0 the segment is recorded DARK and cannot charge;
E(t) = 0.5*C*cap_initial_voltage_v^2 + sum of steps applied up to t - (boot_j at the boot tick) - sum{ energy_j : shunt time_s <= t } - (idle_power_w or off_power_w)*dt per tick according to the model's awake/off state.
Boot-ordering convention, explicitly a transcription choice and not physics: n_boot = ceil(E_on/step) on the first powered window, i.e. the boot fires on the first tick where stored energy reaches E_on and boot_j is debited at that tick; predicted boot energy is n_boot*step - boot_j.
t_boot = n_boot*dt; t_ready = t_boot + boot_delay_s; t_txstart = max(t_ready, tx_not_before_s); t_txdone = t_txstart + ceil(tx_duration_s/dt)*dt.
E_tx = output_v*tx_current_a*tx_duration_s; E_credit = harvest_efficiency*sum_j power_w_j*overlap([t_txstart, t_txdone], segment j) - idle_power_w*tx_duration_s.
Inequalities, each logged with the numeric margin computed from this run's own fields:
(i) t_txdone <= Ddl.
(ii) min over t in [t_txstart, t_txdone] of E(t) >= E_floor, and E(t_ready) - E_floor + E_credit - E_tx >= 0, so the transmission completes without a transient reset and therefore without a duplicate or re-emission.
(iii) max over t in [t_boot, t_txdone] of E(t) <= E_max, so no spill corrupts the charge budget.
(iv) only when L = volatile: E(t) >= E_off for every t in [t_capture, t_txdone], where t_capture is the time_s of the first recorded activity event carrying the required event_id, or service.event_time_s at entry when no capture has been recorded yet. This hold rule is the only place the latch class changes the arithmetic.

STEP 4 - CHANGE-OR-RETAIN.
4.1 RETAIN when STEP 1 is ACHIEVED and the design in force satisfies (i)-(iv) with positive margins: spend no execution, and write down that the post-terminal events are benign decay.
4.2 Otherwise derive a band, not a single knob. Read legal ranges from entry (legal_design_ranges or legal_design_space). For the transmit-timing knob require tx_not_before_s <= t_ready, so the floor never adds capture-to-transmit hold time, and take the smallest legal floor satisfying (i)-(iv). For the capacitance knob, (i) bounds C above through the end of the powered window while (ii) and (iii) bound C below and above through energy; select the interior point that maximizes the minimum of the four margins, and record why each band edge was rejected. Change at most one legal knob per execution, never two at once, and never raise a floor above t_ready in a volatile-latch world.
4.3 Never change a knob in response to a post-terminal event, a shunt or brownout after t_txdone, an unavailable check, or an UNKNOWN qualification.
4.4 Artifact boundary: the consumer chooses D itself inside the legal fields. This H supplies no candidate, no D assignment and no acceptance claim.

STEP 5 - RETROSPECTIVE REHEARSAL GATE (before this H justifies any change).
5.1 Instantiate STEPS 1-4 on the frozen episode the target mechanism came from and recompute every prediction from that episode's own fields.
5.2 Classify each mismatch as TRANSCRIPTION/ARITHMETIC (wrong formula, wrong ceil/floor, dropped boot_j or shunt) or SUBSTANTIVE (wrong mechanism or wrong inequality).
5.3 A transcription mismatch triggers rewriting that formula and redrafting, and the design is kept; only a substantive mismatch triggers the abandon-or-change action of STEP 6. A bare numeric deviation never discards a procedure.
5.4 Illustrative rehearsal outcome, marked illustrative and to be re-derived from the named source hashes rather than hard-coded: on the p3 world (component_record eeb8277f, excitation_record 219fd490) the boot-ordering convention above lands on the recorded first_boot_s with 0 ticks of deviation and puts tx-complete within 1 tick of the recorded packet time, STEP 1 classifies that packet as ACHIEVED (8 bytes, single event id, inside the deadline) so 4.1 retains the design and spends no execution, and the late brownout falls strictly after the last tx-complete and is recorded benign. On the p2 world (component_record 55d43741, excitation_record 2820ae58) the same convention lands on the recorded boot tick and the recorded boot energy, while the recorded loss is attributed by STEP 2 and STEP 3(iv) to a hold plan crossing the dark gap and the scheduled shunt debit, which is a substantive reading rather than arithmetic. The earlier written form ceil((E_on + boot_j)/step), which predicted a later boot than recorded on an achieved design, is the recorded gate miss: classify it TRANSCRIPTION, retain it verbatim, and never flip it into a revert trigger.

STEP 6 - FALSIFIER AND REVERT.
Apply the falsifier stated in this proposal's falsifier field: each prediction names the frozen field that would disconfirm it and a tolerance in dt ticks. A P1/P2/P4 miss beyond tolerance is corrected and redrafted while the design and the miss stay on record; P3 or P5 failure reverts that branch to H0's base method. A firing falsifier is never satisfied or evaded by an unavailable tool, because it is evaluated only from frozen sources and recorded observations.

STEP 7 - UNKNOWN AND COST RULES.
Physical qualification stays UNKNOWN on every branch (p2's check was unavailable, p3's check returned physical_qualification=UNKNOWN), and an ideal-model ledger is not calibration. Record each acquisition's block (bytes, native_calls, new_scientific_executions, wall_seconds) plus the candidate and distinct-design budget actually spent; invoice cost is UNKNOWN and rate-scope estimates are not invoices. Complete service is decided outside the participant and is never claimed here.

STEP 8 - RETENTION AND DELIVERY.

STEP 1 - TRIAGE FIRST (mandatory step 1, before any mechanism is named).
Symbols bound to fields: A = service.application_bytes; Ddl = service.receive_deadline_s; F = saved_activity.packets[]; T_term = max{ saved_activity.activity[k].time_s : that event is tx-complete } (if none, no terminal event exists yet).
Delivery is ACHIEVED iff some packet p in F has p.application_bytes = A, exactly one distinct event id over the required event, and p.time_s <= Ddl. Every activity event with time_s > T_term is POST-TERMINAL: expected decay after the powered window ends. Post-terminal events are recorded and are never a reason to change a knob.
A retained failure is only: no ACHIEVED packet, or an ACHIEVED packet that violates a service field. Classify it as (a) deadline miss, t_txdone > Ddl; (b) no-boot / threshold domain; (c) tx-transient loss, i.e. a brownout with event_was_captured = false or a capture missing after reboot between capture and tx-complete; (d) frame-shape violation (bytes, uniqueness, count).
If no class is present, go to STEP 4.1: retain, and spend no execution.

STEP 2 - READ THIS RUN'S WORLD (never transplant another run's numbers).
Read per run: L = component_record.event_latch in {volatile, passive-mechanical}; Segs = excitation_record.source_segments[] as (start_s, end_s, power_w); Sh = excitation_record.shunts[] as (time_s, energy_j); dt = excitation_record.dt_s; and from component_record: capacitance_f, ready_v, off_v, cap_voltage_max_v, cap_initial_voltage_v, boot_j, boot_delay_s, esr_ohm, output_v, tx_current_a, tx_duration_s, off_power_w, idle_power_w, harvest_efficiency.
Branch on the value class actually present. (i) L = volatile means captured information survives only while the rail stays above its off threshold, so hold inequality (iv) in STEP 3 binds. L = passive-mechanical means the capture is retained across an unpowered interval, so (iv) is recorded NOT_BINDING and only (i)-(iii) govern. The p2 world (event_latch volatile, a high-power early segment, a later low-power segment, a dark gap between them, one shunt at 0.012 s) and the p3 world (passive-mechanical, one single segment [0, 0.020) s, no shunt) are different value classes: neither world's numbers may appear in the other's derivation.

STEP 3 - SYMBOLIC LEDGER (a prediction, computed before an execution is spent).
E_on = 0.5*C*ready_v^2; E_off = 0.5*C*off_v^2; E_max = 0.5*C*cap_voltage_max_v^2;
E_floor = 0.5*C*(output_v + esr_ohm*tx_current_a)^2, the loaded-voltage guard inside transmission, which binds above E_off;
step_j = (power_w_j*harvest_efficiency - off_power_w)*dt for a tick inside segment j; if step_j <= 0 the segment is recorded DARK and cannot charge;
E(t) = 0.5*C*cap_initial_voltage_v^2 + sum of steps applied up to t - (boot_j at the boot tick) - sum{ energy_j : shunt time_s <= t } - (idle_power_w or off_power_w)*dt per tick according to the model's awake/off state.
Boot-ordering convention, explicitly a transcription choice and not physics: n_boot = ceil(E_on/step) on the first powered window, i.e. the boot fires on the first tick where stored energy reaches E_on and boot_j is debited at that tick; predicted boot energy is n_boot*step - boot_j.
t_boot = n_boot*dt; t_ready = t_boot + boot_delay_s; t_txstart = max(t_ready, tx_not_before_s); t_txdone = t_txstart + ceil(tx_duration_s/dt)*dt.
E_tx = output_v*tx_current_a*tx_duration_s; E_credit = harvest_efficiency*sum_j power_w_j*overlap([t_txstart, t_txdone], segment j) - idle_power_w*tx_duration_s.
Inequalities, each logged with the numeric margin computed from this run's own fields:
(i) t_txdone <= Ddl.
(ii) min over t in [t_txstart, t_txdone] of E(t) >= E_floor, and E(t_ready) - E_floor + E_credit - E_tx >= 0, so the transmission completes without a transient reset and therefore without a duplicate or re-emission.
(iii) max over t in [t_boot, t_txdone] of E(t) <= E_max, so no spill corrupts the charge budget.
(iv) only when L = volatile: E(t) >= E_off for every t in [t_capture, t_txdone], where t_capture is the time_s of the first recorded activity event carrying the required event_id, or service.event_time_s at entry when no capture has been recorded yet. This hold rule is the only place the latch class changes the arithmetic.

4.3 Never change a knob in response to a post-terminal event, a shunt or brownout after t_txdone, an unavailable check, or an UNKNOWN qualification.
4.4 Artifact boundary: the consumer chooses D itself inside the legal fields. This H supplies no candidate, no D assignment and no acceptance claim.

5.3 A transcription mismatch triggers rewriting that formula and redrafting, and the design is kept; only a substantive mismatch triggers the abandon-or-change action of STEP 6. A bare numeric deviation never discards a procedure.
5.4 Illustrative rehearsal outcome, marked illustrative and to be re-derived from the named source hashes rather than hard-coded: on the p3 world (component_record eeb8277f, excitation_record 219fd490) the boot-ordering convention above lands on the recorded first_boot_s with 0 ticks of deviation and puts tx-complete within 1 tick of the recorded packet time, STEP 1 classifies that packet as ACHIEVED (8 bytes, single event id, inside the deadline) so 4.1 retains the design and spends no execution, and the late brownout falls strictly after the last tx-complete and is recorded benign.
